subject: Novex site week: itinerary diversion — proposal for a compact 30m walkthrough + async office hours
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novexhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <p.mehta@novexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novex site week — walkthrough + demo (Dec 14, 10:00am)

Thanks for the agenda and for pinning the demo for Tuesday at 10am, Tessa. Quick update from our side: travel's been thrown a little sideways — our VP of Ops had to reroute last minute to support a client in Austin and Priya and I are swapping flights. We still want the session, but we only have a 30-minute window on Tue morning and the rest of the team will be in the floor walkthrough.

Would you be able to compress the walkthrough into a compact 30-minute session focused on the integration touchpoints, or alternatively record a short 25–30 minute demo we can watch before a live 30min Q&A? Either option works; if you can propose a single compact agenda and a backup recording link, that would be ideal. Also, can you share the site floorplan you referenced in case we need to send our onsite lead a quick map?

Appreciate it — Alex

Attachments: (none)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novexhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Novex site week — walkthrough + demo (Dec 14, 10:00am)

Alex — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the travel scramble. Short answer: yes, we can do both options. Proposed approach below, plus a compact agenda attached.

Option A (preferred): Live compact walkthrough \u2014 30 minutes- 10:00-10:30am Tue (Dec 14)- Focus: integration points (data flow, auth/KMS, latency expectations), top three customer use-cases, 5 minutes for next steps- Onsite coverage: Marcus will be onsite to run the north-south demo and handle facilities coordination; I will join remotely for the core integration portion and Q&A

Option B: Pre-recorded 25-30m walkthrough + 30m live officehours- We can record a focused demo and upload the link by Monday EOD; then schedule a 30m live officehours for Tue 10:00-10:30 for any clarifying questions.

I attached a trimmed agenda and the site floorplan you asked for. If you'd prefer Option B, tell us and we'll send the recording link and set the officehours calendar invite.

I'll mark Marcus for onsite coverage and cc'ing Karthik for any logistics/AV escalations.

Best,
Tessa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Novex_Onsite_Agenda_v3.pdf, SiteFloorplan.png
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@novexhealth.com>

Thanks Tessa — Option A sounds perfect. We'll take the live compact 30-minute walkthrough with Marcus onsite and you remote. Can Marcus also run the brief bit that shows offline fallback behavior (we had a question on that earlier)? Priya and I will send the final attendee list by EOD Monday.

Also, please confirm whether you can capture a short recording of the core integration demo (just in case) and share a link after the session that we can use for internal stakeholders who can't attend.

Appreciate the flexibility.
Alex
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Alex — I'll be there in person and will make sure we include the offline fallback section (10 minutes tops) in the compact script. Quick logistics: can your onsite lead grab me a short AV pass and the network room access code when they arrive? If you prefer, I can meet them in the lobby at 9:45.

I'll also record the 20-minute core integration segment and upload the file to the Drive folder immediately after the session; Tessa, I'll share the link with Alex and Priya once uploaded.

See you Tuesday,
Marcus
